results.query: I want to learn web development from scratch
results.retrieved_context: Web development involves building websites and web applications. HTML provides structure, CSS handles styling, and JavaScript adds interactivity. Beginners should start with HTML basics including tags, attributes, and document structure. CSS covers selectors, box model, flexbox, and grid layouts. JavaScript fundamentals include variables, functions, loops, DOM manipulation, and event handling. Recommended resources include freeCodeCamp, The Odin Project, and MDN Web Docs.

results.query: How do I become a data scientist?
results.retrieved_context: Data science combines statistics, programming, and domain expertise. Core skills include Python programming, statistics and probability, data wrangling with pandas, data visualization with matplotlib and seaborn, and machine learning with scikit-learn. Beginners should start with Python basics then move to NumPy and pandas for data manipulation. Kaggle offers free datasets and competitions for practice. SQL is essential for querying databases. Key libraries: pandas, numpy, matplotlib, seaborn, scikit-learn.

results.query: I want to learn machine learning for production
results.retrieved_context: Production machine learning requires understanding of model deployment, MLOps practices, and scalability. Key topics include model versioning with MLflow, containerization with Docker, REST API development with FastAPI or Flask, model monitoring and drift detection, feature stores, and CI/CD pipelines for ML. Cloud platforms AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI, and Azure ML provide managed ML infrastructure. Tools: MLflow, DVC, Airflow, Kubeflow, BentoML.

UI/UX design focuses on creating intuitive and visually appealing digital experiences. UI (User Interface) covers visual design elements like typography, color theory, spacing, and layout. UX (User Experience) involves research, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing. Key tools include Figma for design and prototyping, Adobe XD, and Sketch. Design principles: consistency, hierarchy, contrast, alignment, and proximity. User research methods include interviews, surveys, and usability testing.

results.query: I want to learn Python programming
results.retrieved_context: Python is a versatile, beginner-friendly programming language. Core concepts include variables and data types, control flow with if/else and loops, functions and modules, object-oriented programming with classes, file I/O, and error handling with exceptions. Python's standard library is extensive. Package management with pip. Virtual environments with venv. Popular frameworks: Django and Flask for web, pandas and numpy for data, TensorFlow and PyTorch for ML. CS50P is an excellent free beginner course.

results.query: How to get into digital marketing?
results.retrieved_context: Digital marketing encompasses SEO, social media marketing, content marketing, email marketing, and paid advertising. SEO involves keyword research, on-page optimization, link building, and technical SEO. Social media marketing covers platform strategy for Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, and TikTok. Content marketing involves blogging, video content, and infographics. Google Analytics and Google Search Console are essential tools. Certifications: Google Digital Marketing, HubSpot Academy, Meta Blueprint.

results.query: I want to learn React and become a frontend developer
results.retrieved_context: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces using components. Prerequisites include solid JavaScript knowledge including ES6+ features like arrow functions, destructuring, spread operator, and promises. React core concepts: JSX, components, props, state, and hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext). State management with Redux or Zustand. Routing with React Router. Styling with Tailwind CSS or styled-components. Testing with Jest and React Testing Library. Build tools: Vite or Create React App.

results.query: Prepare me for IELTS exam in 3 months
results.retrieved_context: IELTS (International English Language Testing System) has four sections: Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking. Listening involves 4 recordings with 40 questions. Reading has 3 passages with 40 questions. Writing Task 1 requires describing a graph or diagram in 150 words; Task 2 is an essay of 250 words. Speaking is a face-to-face interview in 3 parts. Practice with Cambridge IELTS books 1-17. British Council and IDP offer official preparation materials. Target band score determines university or visa eligibility.
